general.notes: Aggregate bit rate 41.2 Gb/s; per-lane data rate 10.3 Gb/s (table also lists Bit Rate per Lane BR max 10.313 Mb/sec per ref. 1). Rx sensitivity (OMA) -10.5 dBm and Stressed Receiver Sensitivity (OMA) -8.5 dBm at BER 10^-12. Total Average Launch Power max 8.3 dBm; per-lane Average Launch Power (TXPx) -10.0 to 2.3 dBm; Transmit OMA per lane -6.0 to 3.5 dBm. Transmitter and Dispersion Penalty (TDP) max 2.3 dB; vertical eye closure penalty per lane 1.9 dB. Product is 40GBASE-LR4 Lite (non-standard Lite optical interface per part code). Environmental section references FTL4E1Q for operating temperature; mechanical section references FTL4E1QE1C for QSFP+ MSA compliance.
